author: /root/oraculo_metodo_r2
rule: Odd first hexadecimal nibble maps treatment to CANDIDATE_LEFT; even maps treatment to CANDIDATE_RIGHT.
copy_rule: After arm validity checks, copy output bytes unchanged to the mapped opaque path and record source/output SHA-256 equality without exposing the source path to the blind evaluator.
blind_evaluator_forbidden_before_receipt: seed material, rule or resolved mapping
invalidation: Any byte change to the seed, rule, mapping or copied-output identity invalidates blinding and the pair.
